content:
M5Stack Chain Captain is an ESP32-S3-based multifunctional programmable controller that features a 1.54-inch color square display, a speaker and microphone for audio interaction, motion sensing, and infrared transmission and reception. The IoT controller features 16MB SPI flash and 8MB on-chip PSRAM, Chain and Grove 4-pin ports, a 15-pin GPIO header, and several buttons and RGB. It’s powered by an 800 mAh battery that can be charged at 5V through USB-C or any of the expansion connectors. Chain Captain Dev Kit (ESP32-S3) specifications: SoC – Espressif ESP32-S3R8 CPU – Dual-core Tensilica LX7 microcontroller up to 240 MHz with vector instructions for AI acceleration Memory – 8MB PSRAM Wireless – WiFi 4 and Bluetooth 5.0 LE + Mesh connectivity Storage – 16MB SPI flash Display – 1.54-inch color LCD with 240 x 240 resolution; JD9853A SPI driver Audio ES8311 audio codec AW8737A amplifier 1W / 8Ω speaker MEMS microphone USB – USB [...]
